query:
SELECT p.id, r.firstName, r.lastName, p.packageType, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, (p.totalHours - p.usedHours) as remainingMinutes
FROM packages p
JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id
WHERE p.usedHours < 0
ORDER BY p.usedHours ASC;
